parsed.lens: an on-device, privacy-first user who will not send project files anywhere.

ideas.title: Automated Texture Patching & Conflict Resolution
ideas.who_benefits: Individually-owned artists using Unreal or Unity for personal projects
ideas.job_to_be_done: Automatically detect and repair overlapping textures across ten rendering passes without external tools
ideas.why_this_design: Runs entirely on local GPU with digest identity preventing recomputation, ensuring privacy and speed
ideas.biggest_risk: Latency in local digest sync if network-like dependencies emerge

ideas.title: Local Scene Evolution via Iterative Refinement
ideas.who_benefits: Small indie studios optimizing assets for mobile platforms
ideas.job_to_be_done: Iteratively refine scene layers using filler logic to remove holes and conflicts, guided by neighbour context without cloud upload
ideas.why_this_design: Tetris-like bottom-up clearing with deterministic checks ensures stability and zero data leakage
ideas.biggest_risk: Over-iteration if tile digest identities are misaligned

ideas.title: Privacy-First Asset Restoration & Recombination
ideas.who_benefits: Archival-focused creators preserving old scenes on personal devices
ideas.job_to_be_done: Recombine fragmented layers from memory or backup snapshots using localized rendering and conflict fixing
ideas.why_this_design: Each tile carries neighbour context and digest ID—no files ever leave the machine, preserving ownership
ideas.biggest_risk: Incomplete rebuild if Neural Engine fails to capture full context
